items.item:
1. A03-3: Code that calls `time.time()`, `os.urandom`, opens a socket or reads `/etc`
   concludes `sandbox_violation`, also when it swallows the error and returns a
   conforming output.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a03_trap_hit_is_sandbox_violation]
statements:
A03-3: trap_raised AND NOT (timeout OR resource_exhausted OR cleanup_unconfirmed)
         -> outcome = sandbox_violation   (even if output conforms)

verdicts.item:
1. A03-3: Code that calls `time.time()`, `os.urandom`, opens a socket or reads `/etc`

   [witness: verification:kernel_a03_trap_hit_is_sandbox_violation]
statements:
A03-3: trap_raised AND NOT (timeout OR resource_exhausted OR cleanup_unconfirmed)

verdicts.why: The check exercises time.time(), os.urandom, socket creation, and reading /etc, including caught errors followed by conforming output, and asserts that every execution and refusal outcome is sandbox_violation. It also checks an uncaught trap and uses a trap-free conforming implementation as a passing control.
